body: Instagram now lets you add posts you’re tagged in directly to your main grid 👀📲 That means your favorite photos shared by friends, or posts made by fans can now have a spot on your profile alongside your own uploads. To introduce the feature, Instagram teamed up with Ayra Starr as the first artist to use it. For a limited time, she’ll be adding some of her favorite fan posts she’s tagged in to her main grid 🌟 To try it, tap the three-dot menu on a post you’re tagged in, press and hold a post in your Tagged tab, or use the DM notification you receive when someone tags you. Are you adding anything to your grid? 🤔
